entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I...
I just need a return label. Order number is 774-B-91.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... 774-B-91. I see the order here for a VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, can you tell me what the issue is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's preference. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I don't use it. I want a refund.
I understand. I'm looking at the delivery date and I see the item arrived 18 days ago. Unfortunately, the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window.
Ten days? That's ridiculous. I thought your policy was 90 days.

I apologize for the confusion, sir. Our 90-day policy applies to our apparel, but because the Pulse is a device worn directly on the skin and activates to a personal account, it has that stricter 10-day policy for hygiene and security reasons. Since we are on day 18, I'm unable to process a return for a refund.
So I'm just out the money? This is a complete waste of my time.

Not at all. While a direct return isn't possible, we do have an excellent solution. It's our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we created for our community to buy and sell gently used gear.
A resale marketplace? What's that supposed to do for me?

It allows you to sell the band directly to another VeloFit user. Since the item is barely used, you can often recover most of what you paid. It's very popular for situations just like this. I can send you a direct link with instructions on how to create a listing.
Fine. It's better than nothing. Send me the link.
Of course. I am sending that email to the address on file right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
